plan_name: ACA StandardHealth with Health Choice Zero Cost Share

rule_text: No copayment for preventive drugs mandated by the ACA; certain age or gender limits apply.
Lowest copayment for select drugs that offer the greatest value compared to other drugs used to treat similar conditions.
Low copayment for drugs that offer great value compared to other drugs used to treat similar conditions.
Medium copayment covers brand name drugs that are generally more affordable or may be preferred compared to other drugs used to treat the same conditions.
High copayment covers higher cost brand name and non-preferred generic drugs.
Highest copayment for specialty drugs used to treat complex, chronic conditions and may require special handling, storage, or clinical management.
Coverage for oncology or anti-cancer drugs; cost-share is set equivalent to the member's medical benefit cost-share.
Some drugs are only covered for certain ages.
Some drugs are only covered for a certain amount.
Your doctor must ask for approval from Ambetter before some drugs will be covered.
In some cases, you must first try certain drugs before Ambetter covers another drug for your medical condition.
This product is not covered unless you or your provider request an exception; alternative medications are listed next to the non-covered product.
These products are Specialty Drugs that may have special fill requirements.
Initially, certain medications may only be available in 15-day-supply increments until you are stabilized on the medication.
